summary_1line: After slaying Vritra and incurring brahmanicide, Indra hides in despair until the gods perform an Ashvamedha sacrifice to purify and restore him.

image_candidates.scene_text: The guilt-stricken Indra hides at the edge of the world, withdrawn like a serpent shedding its skin.
The parched earth lies desolate with dried forests and empty rivers as the rain-god Indra remains in hiding.
Gods and rishis gather around a grand Ashvamedha sacrifice altar to cleanse Indra of brahmanicide.
